div.div:
How to read this
Dark card = action / workflow that changes statuses. Rows list entity · from → to, with the condition in italics. Grey dashed card = automatic (celery worker or sequencer). White box = step without a status change. Red dashed arrows = rejection / revision loop. Hover a card for its source file.
